questions.passage: Air pollution happens when harmful gases and particles mix (a) -the air. It is caused by things like cars, factories and burning (b) - fuels. These pollutants can make (c) - air dirty and harmful to breathe. Air pollution can cause (d) - problems like coughing, breathing difficulties and heart diseases. It also harms (e) - environment, affecting plants, animals and the climate. Reducing air pollution is important (f)- keep the air clean. We can help (g)- using less polluting (h) -, recycling and planting trees. Air pollution is (i) - serious problem, but with small (j)-, we can improve the quality of the air we breathe.

questions.passage: Self-control is (a) -the root of all virtues. Let (b) - man give rein to his impulseses (c)- passion, and (d)-that moment he yields up his moral (e) -. He is carried along (f)current of life and becomes the slave (g)-his strongest (h) - for the time being. To be morally free, to be more than (i) - animal, a man must be able to resist instinctive impulse and this can only be done (j)-the exercise of self-control.

options.explanationBn: (a) at the root - মূল অংশে। (b) a man - একজন মানুষ। (c) impulses and passion - আবেগ ও প্রবল ইচ্ছা। (d) from that moment - সেই মুহূর্ত থেকে। (e) moral freedom - নৈতিক স্বাধীনতা। (f) the current - নির্দিষ্ট স্রোত। (g) slave of - দাস। (h) strongest desire - সবচেয়ে শক্তিশালী ইচ্ছা। (i) more than an animal - একটি প্রাণীর চেয়ে বেশি। (j) done by exercise - অনুশীলনের মাধ্যমে সম্পন্ন।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'at the root' - forming the base. (b) 'a man' - any man. (c) 'and' connects 'impulses' and 'passion'. (d) 'from that moment' - starting at that time. (e) 'freedom' is the noun form. (f) 'the current' - specific flow of life. (g) 'slave of' - enslaved by. (h) 'desire' is a strong feeling. (i) 'an animal' - a non-human creature. (j) 'by' indicates the method.

questions.passage: Liberty does not descend (a)-people automatically. People must raise themselves (b) - it. It is (c)-fruit that must be earned (d) - it can be enjoyed. That (e) - means freedom only from foreign (f) - is (g)-outworn idea. No freedom has any real value (h)-it ensures freedom (i) want, disease and ignorance, not merely freedom from (j)- domination.

options.explanationBn: (a) descend on - নেমে আসা। (b) raise to - উন্নীত করা। (c) a fruit - একটি ফল। (d) before - আগে। (e) freedom - স্বাধীনতা। (f) foreign domination - বিদেশী আধিপত্য। (g) an outworn - একটি পুরনো। (h) unless - যদি না। (i) freedom from - থেকে স্বাধীনতা। (j) foreign domination - বিদেশী শাসন।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'descend on' means to fall upon. (b) 'raise to' means to lift to. (c) 'a fruit' - a result. (d) 'before' - prior to. (e) 'freedom' is the state of being free. (f) 'foreign domination' - rule by another country. (g) 'an outworn' - a worn-out/old. (h) 'unless' - except if. (i) 'freedom from' - liberation from. (j) 'foreign' - from another country.

questions.passage: Patriotism is a noble virtue. It is an (a)-instinct in human nature. It inspires a man to shed (b)- drop of blood (c) - defend the liberty and dignity of the country. But patriotism should not be merely (d)-so-called slogan in the public (e)-to fraud the people. It should be remembered in (D)-core of heart and materialized (g) - our deeds. We should keep ourselves above from the fake (h)-. Everybody should bear in mind that a pretender (i) - be defeated. Nobody will remember (j)-honour a mock patriot.

options.explanationBn: (a) inherent instinct - সহজাত প্রবৃত্তি। (b) every drop - প্রতিটি ফোঁটা। (c) to defend - রক্ষা করার জন্য। (d) a slogan - একটি স্লোগান। (e) public meeting - পাবলিক সভা। (f) the core - কেন্দ্রস্থল। (g) in deeds - কাজের মধ্যে। (h) fake patriotism - জাল দেশপ্রেম। (i) must be defeated - পরাজিত হবেই। (j) or honour - অথবা সম্মান।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'inherent' means existing naturally. (b) 'every' means all. (c) 'to defend' shows purpose. (d) 'a' is an article for 'slogan'. (e) 'meeting' is a gathering. (f) 'the core' - the very center. (g) 'in' indicates location (within deeds). (h) 'patriotism' is the noun. (i) 'must' expresses necessity/certainty. (j) 'or' presents an alternative.

questions.passage: Water pollution is (a) -alarming problem in our country. Water is (b)- in many ways. Most of (c)- mills and factories (d) - their waste materials in the rivers. Farmers use pesticides (e) - crops. They flow in the rain and mix (f) - river water. Oil is leaked (g) - launches and steamers. (h)- these reasons are responsible (i) -adulterating water. We must make people (j) -of water pollution.

questions.passage: Dowry means property or money brought (a) -a bride to her husband. During marriage ceremony (b)- section of (c)- people claim much wealth (d)- money from the guardians of (e)-brides. The poor (f)- girls become the victims of (g)- If the guardians fail (h)-fulfil the demand of the bridegroom, the brides are (i)-. So, the poor cannot think (j)-marriage of their daughters. It is a social curse.

options.explanationBn: (a) brought by - দ্বারা আনা। (b) a section - একটি অংশ। (c) greedy people - লোভী মানুষ। (d) wealth or money - অর্থ অথবা সম্পদ। (e) the brides - নির্দিষ্ট বধূ। (f) illiterate girls - অশিক্ষিত মেয়েরা। (g) victims of dowry - যৌতুকের শিকার। (h) fail to fulfil - পূরণ করতে ব্যর্থ। (i) maltreated - খারাপ ব্যবহার করা হয়। (j) think of marriage - বিবাহ চিন্তা করা।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'by' indicates the agent. (b) 'a' is indefinite article. (c) 'greedy' means wanting more than needed. (d) 'or' presents an alternative. (e) 'the' specifies which brides. (f) 'illiterate' means unable to read/write. (g) 'dowry' is the payment. (h) 'to' is used with infinitive 'fulfil'. (i) 'maltreated' means abused. (j) 'of' is used with 'think'.

questions.passage: Water is (a) - important element of the human environment. It is essential (b) - human and plant (c)-. It is next (d) -air. Water can be polluted in many ways. Farmers use chemical (e)- and insecticides in their fields to grow more food. The rain and floods wash (f) -some of the chemicals. They get mixed (g) - river water, canal water and pond water. Mills and factories pollute water and human waste (h) - throwing waste into rivers and canals. Insanitary latrines in the countryside (j)-on the banks of the rivers also pollute water.

options.explanationBn: (a) an important - একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। (b) essential for - জন্য আবশ্যক। (c) plant life - উদ্ভিদ জীবন। (d) next to - পরবর্তী। (e) chemical fertilizers - রাসায়নিক সার। (f) wash away - ভাসিয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়া। (g) mixed with water - পানির সাথে মিশে যাওয়া। (h) waste by throwing - ফেলার মাধ্যমে বর্জ্য। (i) waste the - বর্জ্য পদার্থ। (j) standing on the banks - তীরে অবস্থিত।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'an' is used before 'important' (vowel sound). (b) 'for' indicates purpose/beneficiary. (c) 'life' refers to living things. (d) 'to' in 'next to' means adjacent. (e) 'fertilizers' are plant nutrients. (f) 'away' indicates removal. (g) 'with' indicates mixing. (h) 'by' indicates method. (i) 'the' is definite article. (j) 'standing' means located/positioned.

questions.passage: Gratefulness is one of (a)-super virtues of (b)-. (c)-grateful person is (d)-by all. We mustbe grateful (e)-those (f)-have brought us up. (g) -their affection and care, we would not be able to survive (h)-this earth. We must pray (i)-their eternal peace. It is our (j)-duty.

options.explanationBn: (a) the super virtues - অতীব গুরুত্বপূর্ণ গুণাবলী। (b) of man - মানুষের। (c) A grateful person - একজন কৃতজ্ঞ ব্যক্তি। (d) honoured by all - সবার দ্বারা সম্মানিত। (e) grateful to - প্রতি কৃতজ্ঞ। (f) who have brought - যারা বড় করেছেন। (g) Without affection - স্নেহ ছাড়া। (h) on this earth - এই পৃথিবীতে। (i) pray for - জন্য প্রার্থনা করা। (j) sacred duty - পবিত্র কর্তব্য।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'the' is definite article for 'virtues'. (b) 'man' refers to mankind. (c) 'A' is indefinite article. (d) 'honoured' means respected. (e) 'to' is used with 'grateful'. (f) 'who' is a relative pronoun for people. (g) 'Without' means lacking. (h) 'on' indicates location (on earth). (i) 'for' indicates the object of prayer. (j) 'sacred' means holy/religious.

questions.passage: Students have certain duties (a) - the society. Most of the people (b) - our country are illiterate (c)- the light of education. Education has (d) - power of alleviating the darkness of our soul. Only an educated nation can progress (f)- Students' contribution in other sectors (g)-. They can create awareness (h) - general people about family planning and health issues. (i)-the students come forward, our country will go (j)-long away.

options.explanationBn: (a) duties towards society - সমাজের প্রতি কর্তব্য। (b) people of our country - আমাদের দেশের মানুষ। (c) without the light - আলো ছাড়া। (d) the power - শক্তি। (e) darkness of our soul - আমাদের আত্মার অন্ধকার। (f) progress forward - সামনে এগিয়ে যাওয়া। (g) other sectors too - অন্যান্য খাতেও। (h) awareness among - মধ্যে সচেতনতা। (i) If the students come - যদি শিক্ষার্থীরা এগিয়ে আসে। (j) go a long way - বহুদূর এগিয়ে যাবে।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'towards' indicates direction/relation. (b) 'of' shows origin/belonging. (c) 'without' means lacking. (d) 'the' is definite article. (e) 'darkness' is ignorance. (f) 'forward' means ahead. (g) 'too' means also. (h) 'among' means in a group. (i) 'If' introduces a condition. (j) 'a' is indefinite article before 'long way'.

questions.passage: Money cannot buy happiness. Money is (a) - must for our life. But it does not necessarily (b)- happiness into our lives. Happiness is (c)-a psychological thing. It is the (d)-of a feeling. It means (e)-contentment of the mind. He who is satisfied (f)- what he gets and content (g)-his life is really (h)- one. Happiness can't be purchased with money. No (i) -, money has got something (j)- but it cannot give us absolute happiness.

options.explanationBn: (a) a must - একটি আবশ্যকীয় জিনিস। (b) bring happiness - সুখ আনা। (c) absolutely a psychological - সম্পূর্ণরূপে একটি মানসিক ব্যাপার। (d) the name of a feeling - অনুভূতির নাম। (e) the contentment - তৃপ্তি। (f) satisfied with - সন্তুষ্ট। (g) content with his life - তার জীবন নিয়ে সন্তুষ্ট। (h) really happy one - সত্যিই সুখী ব্যক্তি। (i) No doubt - সন্দেহ নেই। (j) something to do with - কিছু করার আছে।

questions.passage: Where there is a will, there is (a)-way. This proverb is necessarily (b) -. People curse their fate (c)-they cannot get the result as (d) - wishes. But, if a man works really hard (e) - building his future, success will (f) -touch him. There is no magic power. Rather, it is the magic (g)-hard work. (h)-unlucky (i) -rebuke their fate. In fact, there is no alternative (j)-hard work.

options.explanationBn: (a) a way - একটি পথ। (b) necessarily true - অবশ্যই সত্য। (c) when they cannot - যখন তারা পারে না। (d) as their wishes - তাদের ইচ্ছা অনুযায়ী। (e) hard work for building - গঠনের জন্য কঠোর পরিশ্রম। (f) surely touch him - নিশ্চয়ই তাকে স্পর্শ করবে। (g) magic of hard work - কঠোর পরিশ্রমের জাদু। (h) The unlucky people - ভাগ্যহীন মানুষ। (i) people rebuke - মানুষ দোষারোপ করে। (j) alternative to hard work - কঠোর পরিশ্রমের বিকল্প।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'a' is indefinite article. (b) 'true' means correct. (c) 'when' indicates time. (d) 'their' is possessive pronoun. (e) 'for' indicates purpose. (f) 'surely' means certainly. (g) 'of' shows relation. (h) 'The' specifies a group. (i) 'people' is plural noun. (j) 'to' indicates comparison/alternative.

questions.passage: Smoking is (a) - extremely bad habit. Those who are addicted (b) -smoking fall (c) - different types of problems. They suffer from (d) - deadly diseases. Besides, by smoking they waste money (e)-large scale. So, the smokers should give up (f)- bad habit. They should do it for their own health and future. Otherwise, their life will be nothing but (g) - waste. The smokers should also keep (h)- mind that they are creating hazard for the (i) - while they smoke in front of them. They should get rid (j)-this selfish act.

options.explanationBn: (a) an extremely bad habit - একটি অত্যন্ত খারাপ অভ্যাস। (b) addicted to - আসক্ত। (c) fall into different types - বিভিন্ন ধরনের মধ্যে পড়া। (d) various deadly diseases - বিভিন্ন মারাত্মক রোগ। (e) on a large scale - ব্যাপক হারে। (f) give up this bad habit - এই খারাপ অভ্যাস ত্যাগ করা। (g) a waste - একটি অপচয়। (h) keep in mind - মনে রাখা। (i) hazard for others - অন্যদের জন্য বিপদ। (j) get rid of - পরিত্রাণ পাওয়া।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'an' is used before 'extremely' (vowel sound). (b) 'to' is used with 'addicted'. (c) 'into' indicates entering a state. (d) 'various' means different kinds. questions.passage: Today man has been suffering (a) - various diseases. But there is no remedy for some (b)— diseases. So human beings are subject (c) - decay and death. One day, he will depart (d) - this world. Here he cannot live for (e) - long time. But he can live in (f) - memory of people through his (g) -. Therefore, we should do things (h) - our life which will remain unforgettable. We may not (i) -in the world in flesh and blood for ever but we can surely stay in the minds of people (j)-our works.

options.explanationBn: (a) suffering from - ভোগা। (b) fatal diseases - মারাত্মক রোগ। (c) subject to - সাপেক্ষ। (d) depart from - চলে যাওয়া। (e) for a long time - দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে। (f) in the memory - স্মৃতিতে। (g) through his work - তার কাজের মাধ্যমে। (h) in our life - আমাদের জীবনে। (i) remain in the world - দুনিয়ায় থাকা। (j) through our works - আমাদের কাজের মাধ্যমে।

questions.passage: Man cannot live (a) - food. (b) - fact, no living things, animals or (c)- can survive without food. The collection (d) - food was man's first job. He made his first weapons in order (e)- hunt animals for food. Gradually, he learnt how (f) - grow plants. Thus he invented (g) - and settled in communities (h) -his cornfields. Today, men are engaged (i) - food adulteration. When you eat (j)-outside food, you are not sure whether you are eating a food or a poison.

options.explanationBn: (a) live without food - খাদ্য ছাড়া বাঁচা। (b) In fact - আসলে। (c) animals or plants - প্রাণী বা উদ্ভিদ। (d) collection of food - খাদ্য সংগ্রহ। (e) in order to hunt - শিকার করার উদ্দেশ্যে। (f) how to grow - কিভাবে উৎপাদন করতে হয়। (g) invented agriculture - কৃষি আবিষ্কার করল। (h) beside his cornfields - তার ধান ক্ষেতের পাশে। (i) engaged in - জড়িত। (j) an outside food - একটি বাইরের খাবার।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'without' means lacking. (b) 'In fact' is a discourse marker. (c) 'plants' are living organisms. (d) 'of' shows relation. (e) 'to' (infinitive) shows purpose. questions.passage: Yesterday, I was going to school on foot. I crossed a busy road (a) - Cars were moving (b)- great speed. I waited (c)- the signal to turn green. A policeman was standing (d)- the corner. He was wearing (e) - orange uniform. People were (f) - on both sides. Some were running to (g) - the bus. I saw (h) - old man crossing the road. It was (i)- busy morning. (j)-I was able to reach school on time.

options.explanationBn: (a) crossed carefully - সাবধানে পার হলাম। (b) at great speed - দ্রুত গতিতে। (c) waited for - অপেক্ষা করলাম। (d) standing at the corner - কোণায় দাঁড়ানো। (e) an orange uniform - একটি কমলা রঙের ইউনিফর্ম। (f) walking on both sides - উভয় পাশে হাঁটছিল। (g) running to catch the bus - বাস ধরতে দৌড়ানো। (h) an old man - একজন বৃদ্ধ। (i) a busy morning - একটি ব্যস্ত সকাল। (j) Finally - সবশেষে।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'carefully' means with caution. (b) 'at' indicates rate/speed. (c) 'for' is used with 'waited'. (d) 'at' indicates position. (e) 'an' is used before 'orange' (vowel sound). (f) 'walking' means moving on foot. (g) 'catch' means to board/obtain. (h) 'an' is used before 'old' (vowel sound). (i) 'a' is indefinite article. (j) 'Finally' means at last.

questions.passage: One day, a fox was looking (a) - food. He (b) - some grapes hanging (c)-a tree. The grape looked tempting and (d) -. The fox jumped to catch them (e) - failed. He tried (f)-and again but could not reach them. At last, he said, "(g) - grapes are sour!" and walked (h)-. This story teaches us (i)-lesson: we (j)-not give up so easily.

options.explanationBn: (a) looking for food - খাবারের খোঁজে। (b) saw some grapes - কিছু আঙ্গুর দেখল। (c) hanging on a tree - গাছে ঝুলছে। (d) tempting and juicy - লোভনীয় ও রসালো। (e) but failed - কিন্তু ব্যর্থ হল। (f) tried again and again - বারবার চেষ্টা করল। (g) These grapes are sour! - এই আঙ্গুরগুলো টক! (h) walked away - চলে গেল। (i) a lesson - একটি শিক্ষা। (j) should not give up - হাল ছাড়া উচিত নয়।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'for' indicates object of search. (b) 'saw' means perceived with eyes. (c) 'on' indicates position. (d) 'juicy' means full of juice. (e) 'but' indicates contrast. (f) 'again' means another time. (g) 'These' refers to plural nearby objects. (h) 'away' indicates departure. (i) 'a' is indefinite article. (j) 'should' indicates advice/obligation.

questions.passage: Last month, I (a) - a village fair. The fair was full (b) - people. There was (c)- big Ferris wheel. I sat (d) - my friends on it. There were many stalls selling (e) - food. I (f) - cotton candy. It tasted (g) - sweet. My father (h)- some balloons for me. It was (i) -joyful day. I enjoyed the fair (j)-much.

options.explanationBn: (a) visited a fair - মেলা ঘুরলাম। (b) full of people - মানুষের ভিড়। (c) a big wheel - একটি বড় চাকা। (d) sat with my friends - বন্ধুদের সাথে বসলাম। (e) selling delicious food - সুস্বাদু খাবার বিক্রি। (f) ate cotton candy - তুলার মিঠাই খেলাম। (g) tasted very sweet - খুব মিষ্টি লাগল। (h) bought some balloons - কিছু বেলুন কিনল। (i) a joyful day - একটি আনন্দের দিন। (j) very much - খুব বেশি।

options.explanationBn: (a) went to our home - আমাদের বাড়িতে গেলাম। (b) My grandparents live - আমার দাদা-দাদি থাকেন। (c) quiet and peaceful - শান্ত ও নির্মল। (d) a river - একটি নদী। (e) delicious food - সুস্বাদু খাবার। (f) many old stories - অনেক পুরনো গল্প। (g) played with my cousins - আমার চাচাতো ভাইদের সাথে খেললাম। (h) walked across the fields - মাঠ পেরিয়ে হাঁটলাম। (i) an amazing trip - একটি চমৎকার ভ্রমণ। (j) very much - খুব বেশি।

questions.passage: Every day, I wake up (a) - the morning. I go for a (b) - in the park. The air is (c) -and fresh. Birds sing (d) -the trees. I walk (e) - thirty minutes. My grandfather (f) - with me. He always tells me (g)-. Morning walks make us (h) -. I feel (i) — happy after a walk. It is (j) -good habit.

options.explanationBn: (a) wake up in the morning - সকালে ঘুম থেকে ওঠা। (b) go for a walk - হাঁটতে যাওয়া। (c) cool and fresh - ঠান্ডা ও সতেজ। (d) sing on the trees - গাছে গান করে। (e) walk for thirty minutes - ত্রিশ মিনিট হাঁটা। (f) walks with me - আমার সাথে হাঁটে। (g) tells me stories - আমাকে গল্প শোনায়। (h) make us healthy - আমাদের সুস্থ করে। (i) feel very happy - খুব খুশি লাগে। (j) a good habit - একটি ভালো অভ্যাস।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'in' is used with parts of the day. (b) 'walk' is the noun. (c) 'cool' means slightly cold. (d) 'on' indicates position. (e) 'for' indicates duration. (f) 'walks' means moves on foot. (g) 'stories' are narratives. (h) 'healthy' means in good health. (i) 'very' emphasizes 'happy'. (j) 'a' is indefinite article.

questions.passage: Honesty is a great (a) -. An honest man (b) - liked and trusted by all. A dishonest man (c)- unfair means with a view to (d) -his objectives. (e) - every walk of life, honesty is (f)- must. (g)-honest man may be poor (h) -he does not (i) -to become rich by adopting dishonest (j)-

options.explanationBn: (a) a great virtue - একটি মহৎ গুণ। (b) is liked and trusted - পছন্দ ও বিশ্বাস করা হয়। (c) adopts unfair means - অসৎ উপায় অবলম্বন করে। (d) achieving his objectives - তার লক্ষ্য অর্জন। (e) In every walk of life - জীবনের প্রতিটি ক্ষেত্রে। (f) a must - একটি আবশ্যক। (g) An honest man - একজন সৎ মানুষ। (h) but he does not - কিন্তু সে না। (i) try to become rich - ধনী হওয়ার চেষ্টা করে। (j) dishonest means - অসৎ উপায়।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'virtue' is moral excellence. (b) 'is' is the verb. (c) 'adopts' means takes up/uses. (d) 'achieving' means reaching a goal. (e) 'In' indicates context. (f) 'a' makes 'must' a noun. (g) 'An' is used before 'honest' (vowel sound). (h) 'but' indicates contrast. (i) 'try' means attempt. (j) 'means' are methods/ways.

questions.passage: One day two cats (a) - a piece of cake. Each of them demanded the larger share (b) -the cake. None of them (c)- to compromise a bit. Both of them (d) - to go to (e) - monkey. The monkey brought (f) - scale to divide the bread (g) -. At first the cake was (h) - into two pieces. (i)- the monkey put them (j) -the scales.

options.explanationBn: (a) found a piece - একটি টুকরা পেল। (b) share of the cake - কেকের অংশ। (c) agreed to compromise - আপোষ করতে রাজি। (d) decided to go - যাওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত নিল। (e) to a monkey - একটি বানরের কাছে। (f) a scale - একটি দাঁড়িপাল্লা। (g) divide equally - সমানভাবে ভাগ করা। (h) cut into two pieces - দু'টুকরো করা। (i) Then the monkey - তারপর বানরটি। (j) put them on the scales - দাঁড়িপাল্লায় রাখল।
options.explanationEn: (a) 'found' means discovered. (b) 'of' shows relation. (c) 'agreed' means said yes. (d) 'decided' means made a choice. (e) 'a' is indefinite article. (f) 'a' is indefinite article. (g) 'equally' means in the same manner. (h) 'cut' means divided with a blade. (i) 'Then' indicates next in sequence. (j) 'on' indicates surface.

questions.passage: Dr. Muhammad Yunus is (a) - founder of Grameen Bank. He has built (b)-this bank to help the poor and landless (c)-of the country. His purpose (d)-to remove poverty and make the (e) -people self-sufficient. His (f) - credit programme has contributed (g) - lot to our socio-economic development. He was (h)- the Nobel Prize for Peace in 2006 (i) - his great contribution in the field (j)- poverty alleviation.

options.explanationBn: (a) the founder - প্রতিষ্ঠাতা। (b) built up - গড়ে তুলেছেন। (c) poor and landless people - দরিদ্র ও ভূমিহীন মানুষ। (d) purpose is - উদ্দেশ্য হল। (e) the poor people - দরিদ্র মানুষ। (f) micro credit programme - ক্ষুদ্র ঋণ কর্মসূচি। (g) contributed a lot - অনেক অবদান রেখেছে। (h) awarded the Nobel Prize - নোবেল পুরস্কার পেয়েছেন। (i) for his great contribution - তার মহান অবদানের জন্য। (j) in the field of - ক্ষেত্রে।
